title: Hanford's container record progresses from more than 20 produced to 66 shipped
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy Office of Environmental Management
summary: DOE reported more than 20 immobilized-waste containers in December 2025, Washington Ecology reported 34 by February 2026, and May project minutes reported 66 shipped to the Integrated Disposal Facility. Denominator: Three dated container observations under distinct produced, regulator-observed, and shipped stages; the counts are not treated as one accepted or disposed series.
